name: agentree
description: Create and manage isolated git worktrees for AI coding agents

scripts.build: bun run generate && bunli build --entry src/cli.ts && bun run sync:completion-assets
scripts.build:binaries: bun run generate && bunli build --entry src/cli.ts --targets darwin-arm64,darwin-x64,linux-arm64,linux-x64,windows-x64 && bun run sync:completion-assets
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
